items.title: Tata Steel Q2 Results: Profit rises 16% YoY to Rs 3,700 crore, revenue up 11%; Noel Tata to retire as director
items.description: Tata Group's Tata Steel has reported a 16.2% year-on-year increase in profit after tax for Q2FY27. Consolidated revenue from operations grew by 11.5% year-on-year, reaching over Rs 65,436 crore. The profit after tax for the quarter was around Rs 3,700 crore, compared to the previous year's amount. Additionally, Noel Naval Tata will retire from his position effective November 11, 2026.

items.title: Websol Energy Q2 Results: PAT jumps 73% YoY to Rs 80 crore; revenue more than doubles to Rs 361 crore
items.description: Websol Energy System reported a 73.2% rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 80.21 crore, while revenue surged 114.6% to Rs 361.02 crore. The company plans a 4 GW solar cell manufacturing expansion at Falta and entry into EPC, solar IPP and energy trading businesses.

items.title: Divi's Labs Q2 Results: PAT surges 64% YoY to Rs 1,127 crore; revenue jumps 35%
items.description: Divi's Laboratories has achieved a remarkable profit surge of 63.6% year-on-year for the September quarter of FY27, driven by a 35.4% increase in operational revenue, totaling Rs 3,676 crore. The company's total income reached Rs 3,770 crore in Q2FY27, while the first half of the fiscal year saw total earnings hit Rs 6,907 crore.
